description: `scenario-completeness-scoring score get <scenario> [--json]` returns in <1s warm with zero network calls on the core path, computed purely from cached filesystem artifacts of the target scenario.

requirements.description: The CLI command `scenario-completeness-scoring score get <scenario> [--json]` must return a complete score response within 1 second on a warm execution (artifacts already on disk). The entire core computation must be performed exclusively from cached filesystem artifacts of the target scenario — specifically requirements/index.json, coverage/requirements-sync metadata, coverage/phase-results/*.json, coverage/runs.index.json, .vrooli/service.json, and ui/src scan. Zero network calls are permitted on the core score path. The implementation must reside in api/internal/signals, api/internal/freshness, and api/internal/scoring domains.
requirements.title: Score Read Path Sub-Second Warm Response with Zero Network Calls

validation.notes: api/internal/scoring/score_read_path_test.go: table test verifying score computation completes against fixture artifact dirs with no outbound calls (mock http transport returns error to confirm zero calls)
api/internal/signals/collector_test.go: verify each signal collector reads only from provided filesystem paths and performs no network I/O
api/internal/scoring/score_read_path_test.go [REQ:OT-P0-001]: verify function returns populated ScoreResult struct from well-formed fixture dir
cmd/score/score_integration_test.go: spin up temp scenario dir with real tree digest and synthetic coverage/runs.index.json, invoke GetScore over Connect-RPC, assert response arrives within 1s warm
cli golden test: run `score get <scenario>` against a real scenario checkout and assert exit code 0 with non-empty output
time 3 warm runs of `score get` against a real scenario checkout; each run must complete in <1000ms
pprof trace must show zero net/http dial calls during core score path execution
Catalog consumers can retrieve a scenario score from CLI without requiring any network connectivity or live service dependencies
